final: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM molecule m INNER JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'f')) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'), 2) as percentage_without_fluorine
